title: Search hit paths stored absolute, displayed relative; matches list is per-file not per-hit
context: Search consumers need absolute paths; display is relative to search root. A file matching on name has no matches inside to point at.
decision: SearchHit.path is absolute. SearchHit.matches is empty for name-only matches, otherwise lists every place inside file the query matched.
consequences: Locator tree walks absolute path back to search root. Results can show '417 results in 32 files'. File row with no nested matches is still a stop.
